description: This file implements the core functions for an Advanced Networking Service Container (ANSC) Broker Socket TCP Object, including creation, initialization, object enrollment, and destruction, as well as setting up object methods and internal state management.

classes.name: ANSC_BROKER_SOCKET_TCP_OBJECT
classes.description: Represents the TCP broker socket object with member variables for socket state, address info, buffers, and function pointers for socket operations.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE AnscBktoCreate(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Constructs and initializes a new instance of the ANSC BROKER SOCKET TCP object.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscBktoRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Performs cleanup and deallocates resources associated with the TCP socket object.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscBktoEnrollObjects(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Enrolls ancillary objects required by the TCP socket object.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscBktoInitialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes member variables and function pointers of the TCP socket object.
